panels.title: ABOUT
panels.text: The source of [www.velimir-mueller.de](https://www.velimir-mueller.de): portfolio, services and live demos, plus a private admin. It sets no cookies. It still remembers your language, for the length of one URL.

items.text: Requirements, UX/UI, full-stack code, automated deployment.
A visit sets no cookie, so the site needs no consent banner.
A CRM dashboard, an MCP demo and an arcade shooter in WASM.
A private area at `/admin`: contact inbox, cookieless traffic KPIs and a Magic: The Gathering collection.
`npm run dev` serves the app on [localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000).

nodes.title: components/

items.text: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript (strict), Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Vercel. Tests: Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright. AI tooling: Claude AI.

Monochrome + accent, full dark mode. Bento grid with `rounded-[1.5rem]` cards, monospace labels and data, subtle grid backgrounds and blur gradients, hover micro-animations, green pulse indicators for availability.
`next-intl` runs with `localeCookie: false`. `e2e/headers.spec.ts` asserts that public pages set no cookie. hCaptcha loads only when the contact form is sent.
The architecture and the page list are in `docs/REFERENCE.md`.

rows.text: Playwright visual regression tests. `-- --update-snapshots` writes new baselines.
Playwright E2E tests. `-- --grep "Navigation"` runs one group.

items.text: Jest with React Testing Library.
Playwright screenshots every Storybook story and compares it with the baseline. Config `playwright-storybook.config.ts`, tests `e2e/storybook-visual.spec.ts`.

[Playwright](https://playwright.dev/) against the production build: navigation, theme/language toggle, contact form, service pages, project demos and 404 handling. Config `playwright.config.ts`, tests `e2e/app.spec.ts`.
[Storybook](https://storybook.js.org/) is the component library and the visual documentation, on `localhost:6006`.
**Atoms:** Button, CodeBlock, LanguageToggle. **Molecules:** BentoCard, SectionHeader. **Organisms:** Navigation, Footer.
Autodocs, controls panel, dark/light toolbar toggle, responsive viewport presets, accessibility (a11y) audit panel.

items.text: Contact inbox, traffic KPIs (v2.1.0), Magic (v2.2.0). English only, `noindex`, disallowed in `robots.txt`.
Supabase Auth magic link for one admin user. Middleware, `requireAdmin()` and Postgres RLS via `public.is_admin()` check it. No service-role key.
Lives in `src/config/admin.ts` **and** in the migration. Change both together.
In `supabase/migrations/`. Apply them in the Supabase SQL editor.
Analytics needs `ANALYTICS_INGEST_SECRET` in Vercel. The Magic catalog loader needs `SUPABASE_DB_URL`.
Every table, setup step, keyboard shortcut and Supabase Auth setting is in `docs/REFERENCE.md`.

code:
git clone https://github.com/VelimirMueller/portfolio-website.git
cd portfolio-website
npm install
cp .env.example .env.local   # add your Supabase URL and anon key
npm run dev

npm test                                      # all unit tests
npm run test:visual -- --update-snapshots     # new visual baselines
npm run test:e2e -- --grep "Navigation"       # one E2E group
npm run storybook                             # localhost:6006
